evals.name: Unit Test Isolation and Coverage Threshold Configuration
evals.prompt: Configure a test runner (Jest or Vitest) with strict CI coverage thresholds (80% lines, 75% branches), and write a pure unit test with mocked dependencies and sub-millisecond execution.
evals.expected_output: Configures coverage threshold in test runner config and implements an isolated unit test using mock dependencies and fake timers.
assertions: Configures test runner thresholds for minimum 80% line coverage and 75% branch coverage
Ensures unit tests execute with zero external network or database I/O using mocks
Maintains deterministic test execution without unseeded random values or unmocked timers
Focuses individual unit tests on a single logical assertion or behavior

evals.name: Testcontainers Integration Test with Transaction Rollback Isolation
evals.prompt: Implement an integration test harness using Testcontainers for PostgreSQL, running database migrations before tests and wrapping each test in an isolated transaction that rolls back.
evals.expected_output: Builds singleton Testcontainers manager for PostgreSQL, executes migrations pre-suite, and wraps tests with withRollbackTransaction helper.
assertions: Launches ephemeral PostgreSQL container using Testcontainers singleton lifecycle
Executes database schema migrations prior to running the integration test suite
Executes each test inside a dedicated transaction that unconditionally rolls back upon completion
Guarantees test isolation and prevents mutated state pollution across test runs

evals.name: Post-Deployment Smoke Testing & k6 Performance SLA Verification
evals.prompt: Author an automated post-deployment smoke test script and a k6 load test script with strict latency SLA thresholds (p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms, error rate < 0.1%).
evals.expected_output: Creates deployment smoke script verifying /health/ready and 401 error envelope, plus k6 script asserting p50/p95/p99 and error rate thresholds.
assertions: Verifies readiness probe (/health/ready) returns HTTP 200 after deployment rollout
Validates security error contracts on unauthenticated API requests in smoke test
Defines k6 performance stages for concurrency ramp-up and steady state load
Enforces strict SLA thresholds on p50 (<50ms), p95 (<200ms), p99 (<500ms), and error rate (<0.1%)
